highlights: RAG agent: designed the ONUtech RAG agent (FastAPI, LangChain, ChromaDB, Gemini embeddings, Llama 3.3 via Groq), reducing document access time by 60%.
Document ingestion: automated PDF loading in Python, with chunking and vector indexing of the content in ChromaDB.
Reporting: exploratory analysis of business activity and Power BI dashboards to track key indicators.
Automation: data flows built on the WhatsApp Business API and n8n workflows, with pipeline monitoring.
Quote agent: designed an AI agent that cut manual request processing time by 80%.
Data extraction: automatic extraction of information (OCR, GPT-4o) from emails, PDFs and forms.
Pricing engine: price calculation on PostgreSQL, served through a FastAPI API with Redis caching, and PDF quote generation.
OCR model: developed a CNN-BiLSTM-CTC deep learning model that automatically transcribes civil registry records.
ETL pipeline: centralized data from several civil registry centers, with validation, cleaning and dynamic CSV schema handling.
Production loading: dual storage (raw staging and normalized production), a composite unique ID per record (uniqueid) and secure synchronization with PostgreSQL.
